blocks.text: Galerie Bene Taschen presents Italy a solo exhibition by German-Ukrainian photographer Miron Zownir (*1953, Karlsruhe, Germany). Taken between 2017 and 2024 in cities across northern and southern Italy as well as rural Apulia, the photographs offer a window onto the country’s many social realities.

Zownir’s photographs have been shown internationally in numerous solo and group exhibitions. Major institutional exhibitions include El Salvaje Europeo at the Centre de Cultura Contemporània de Barcelona (2004); DARKSIDE I and II at Fotomuseum Winterthur (2008–09); a retrospective at the Haus der Photographie, Deichtorhallen Hamburg (2016); and Zeitwirdknapp / Non c’è più tempo at the Centro Internazionale di Fotografia in Palermo (2021).

His work has also been shown at the Museum für Fotografie in Berlin, the Museum für Kunst und Gewerbe Hamburg, the Weserburg in Bremen, and the Kunstmuseum Gelsenkirchen. In 2023–24, fifty of Zownir’s photographs were featured in the exhibition Dix and the Present at the Deichtorhallen Hamburg, where his work was placed in direct dialogue with that of Otto Dix.
